target_roles.title: VP of Product Development
target_roles.rationale: As a Fortune 500 materials manufacturer producing their own protective films with 5-12 year outdoor durability claims, the VP of Product Development owns product portfolio strategy and competitive differentiation in a crowded market against 3M, HP, and other major players. Tedlar's 12-20+ year proven lifespan and superior UV/graffiti resistance represents a potential technology licensing opportunity or co-development partnership that would extend Avery Dennison's premium product line and deliver measurably better warranty performance. This role cares about: (1) extending product lifespan beyond current 12-year max to capture ultra-premium architectural and transit segments, (2) reducing warranty claims from UV degradation and cracking that impact brand reputation, (3) differentiating from 3M's Scotchcal and other competitive wrapping films through provable 20+ year performance data. Given Avery Dennison's massive fleet projects (30,000 DPD vehicles) and architectural applications, a protective overlaminate with Tedlar's graffiti-cleaning properties could become a value-added upsell layer for their Supreme Wrapping Film line, addressing customer pain points around vandalism on high-visibility transit and building wraps.

target_roles.title: Director of Innovation
target_roles.rationale: With 90 years in vinyl graphic films and active presence at ISA and FESPA trade shows, Avery Dennison's Innovation Director is tasked with identifying next-generation technologies that maintain market leadership as the industry shifts toward longer-life, lower-maintenance solutions. Tedlar's 60+ years of proven PVF chemistry and -70°F to 230°F operating range addresses emerging customer demands in extreme-climate architectural projects and transit interiors where current cast vinyl technology reaches performance limits. This role personally owns: (1) scouting external IP and material science breakthroughs that can leapfrog competitive offerings, (2) validating new substrate technologies that reduce total cost of ownership for end customers (fewer replacements = stronger customer retention), (3) building innovation pipeline for sustainability-focused clients seeking ultra-durable alternatives to frequent vinyl replacement cycles. The innovation case is compelling: integrating Tedlar as a protective top layer would allow Avery Dennison to offer a 'Platinum Series' with documented 20-year outdoor warranties, opening new revenue in municipal transit contracts, architectural facade systems, and premium fleet graphics where durability specifications exceed current product capabilities.

target_roles.title: VP of Marketing
target_roles.rationale: Leading a $8.77B graphics division competing directly with 3M requires aggressive market positioning around proven performance claims that resonate with sign manufacturers, wrap installers, and architects. The VP of Marketing owns competitive messaging, brand differentiation, and customer acquisition in segments where Tedlar's documented 60+ year track record and graffiti resistance create powerful proof points. This role cares about: (1) substantiating outdoor durability claims with third-party validated data that withstands competitive scrutiny at ISA and FESPA events, (2) addressing customer churn caused by premature fading/cracking complaints that damage brand reputation in the wrap installer community, (3) creating premium tier messaging for architectural and transit segments where Avery Dennison currently loses deals to specialty PVF-based solutions. Strategic opportunity: Co-marketing partnership where Tedlar's heritage brand (60+ years) validates Avery Dennison's premium positioning, enabling joint case studies from the DPD fleet project and architectural installations that demonstrate superior graffiti cleaning and zero-yellowing performance. This directly supports marketing's need to win high-visibility municipal and corporate accounts where specification documents increasingly require 15-20 year performance warranties that exceed current product capabilities.
